-- EDFM surface-mining prospecting observations.
-- The JSON data page is the canonical source; this module only formats it.
local p = {}
local data = mw.loadJsonData('Module:Data/SurfaceMiningProspecting')

local GROUND_LABELS = {
    ['metal-rich'] = 'Metal rich',
    ['high-metal-content'] = 'High metal content',
    ['rocky-ice'] = 'Rocky ice',
    ['rocky'] = 'Rocky',
    ['icy'] = 'Icy',
    ['volcanic magma'] = 'Volcanic — magma',
    ['volcanic silicate'] = 'Volcanic — silicate',
}

local FAMILY_LABELS = {
    volcanic = 'Volcanic',
    metal = 'Metal',
    rock = 'Rock',
    ice = 'Ice',
}

local FAMILY_ORDER = { 'volcanic', 'metal', 'rock', 'ice' }
local MONTHS = {
    'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
    'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
}

local function escape(value)
    return (tostring(value or ''):gsub('[&<>"\'{}%[%]|!\n\r]', function(c)
        return '&#' .. string.byte(c) .. ';'
    end))
end

local function trim(value)
    return mw.text.trim(tostring(value or ''))
end

local function diagnostic(message)
    return '<strong class="error">Surface-mining prospecting data error: ' .. escape(message) .. '</strong>'
end

local function humanizeId(value)
    return (value:gsub('-', ' '):gsub('^%l', string.upper))
end

local function groundLabel(value)
    local id = trim(value)
    return GROUND_LABELS[id] or humanizeId(id)
end

local function familyLabel(value)
    local id = trim(value)
    return FAMILY_LABELS[id] or humanizeId(id)
end

local function percentage(value)
    return string.format('%.1f%%', tonumber(value) or 0)
end

local function sample(observation)
    return escape(observation.hits) .. ' / ' .. escape(observation.locations_surveyed)
end

local function listLength(list)
    local count = 0
    for _ in ipairs(list or {}) do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end

local function bestObservation(observations)
    local best = observations[1]
    local bestIndex = 1
    for index, observation in ipairs(observations or {}) do
        if not best or (tonumber(observation.observed_percentage) or 0) > (tonumber(best.observed_percentage) or 0) then
            best = observation
            bestIndex = index
        end
    end
    return best, bestIndex
end

local function materialId(frame)
    local args = frame.args or {}
    local parent = frame:getParent()
    local id = args[1] or args.id
    if not id and parent then id = parent.args[1] or parent.args.id end
    if not id or trim(id) == '' then
        id = mw.ustring.lower(mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text):gsub('%s+', '_')
    end
    return trim(id)
end

local function material(id)
    for _, item in ipairs(data.materials or {}) do
        if item.commodity == id then return item end
    end
    return nil
end

local function tableOutput(headers, rows, className)
    local classes = className or 'wikitable'
    local out = {
        '{| class="' .. classes .. '" style="white-space:normal"',
        '! ' .. table.concat(headers, ' !! '),
    }
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        out[#out + 1] = '|-'
        out[#out + 1] = '| ' .. table.concat(row, '\n| ')
    end
    out[#out + 1] = '|}'
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

local function observationsTable(item)
    local rows = {}
    for _, observation in ipairs(item.observations or {}) do
        rows[#rows + 1] = {
            escape(groundLabel(observation.ground)),
            escape(observation.hits),
            escape(observation.locations_surveyed),
            percentage(observation.observed_percentage),
        }
    end
    return tableOutput({'Ground', 'Found', 'Surveyed', 'Observed rate'}, rows, 'wikitable sortable')
end

local function detailBlock(item, bestIndex)
    local observations = item.observations or {}
    if listLength(observations) <= 1 then return '' end

    local out = {
        '<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed edfm-prospecting-detail" data-expandtext="View other observations" data-collapsetext="Hide other observations">',
        '<div class="edfm-prospecting-detail-label">Other observed ground</div>',
        '<ul class="edfm-prospecting-detail-list">',
    }
    for index, observation in ipairs(observations) do
        if index ~= bestIndex then
            out[#out + 1] = '<li><span class="edfm-prospecting-detail-ground">'
                .. escape(groundLabel(observation.ground))
                .. '</span> — <strong class="edfm-prospecting-detail-rate">'
                .. percentage(observation.observed_percentage)
                .. '</strong> <span class="edfm-prospecting-detail-sample">('
                .. sample(observation) .. ')</span></li>'
        end
    end
    out[#out + 1] = '</ul>'
    out[#out + 1] = '</div>'
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

local function primaryRow(item)
    local observations = item.observations or {}
    local best, bestIndex = bestObservation(observations)
    local materialName = item.name or item.commodity
    return {
        '<strong class="edfm-prospecting-material">' .. escape(materialName) .. '</strong>'
            .. detailBlock(item, bestIndex),
        '<span class="edfm-prospecting-ground">' .. escape(groundLabel(best.ground)) .. '</span>',
        '<strong class="edfm-prospecting-rate">' .. percentage(best.observed_percentage) .. '</strong>',
        '<span class="edfm-prospecting-sample">' .. sample(best) .. '</span>',
    }
end

local function familyTable(family)
    local rows = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(data.materials or {}) do
        if item.family == family then
            rows[#rows + 1] = primaryRow(item)
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then return '' end

    local className = 'edfm-prospecting-family edfm-prospecting-family--' .. escape(family)
    local out = {
        '<div class="' .. className .. '">',
        '<h3 class="edfm-prospecting-family-heading">' .. escape(familyLabel(family)) .. '</h3>',
        '<div class="edfm-prospecting-table-wrap">',
        tableOutput({'Material', 'Best observed ground', 'Observed rate', 'Sample'}, rows, 'wikitable edfm-prospecting-table'),
        '</div>',
        '</div>',
    }
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

local function allFamilyTables()
    local out = {
        '<div class="edfm-prospecting-reference">',
    }
    for _, family in ipairs(FAMILY_ORDER) do
        local section = familyTable(family)
        if section ~= '' then out[#out + 1] = section end
    end
    out[#out + 1] = '</div>'
    return table.concat(out, '\n\n')
end

local function humanDate(value)
    local year, month, day = tostring(value or ''):match('^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)')
    if year and month and day and MONTHS[tonumber(month)] then
        return tonumber(day) .. ' ' .. MONTHS[tonumber(month)] .. ' ' .. year
    end
    return escape(value or 'an unknown date')
end

local function attributionLine()
    local attribution = data.attribution or {}
    local contributor = escape(attribution.contributor or 'CMDR Grumlop')
    return '<p>The prospecting data on this page was researched and contributed by <strong>'
        .. contributor
        .. '</strong>, who surveyed Planetary Mining Locations and recorded the materials shown on the in-game target panel.</p>'
        .. '<p>The percentages shown here are based on those observations. For example, if a material appears at 30% for a particular ground type, that means it was found at roughly 30% of the surveyed mining locations of that type. These figures are community research rather than official Frontier-published spawn or drop rates.</p>'
        .. '<p>' .. contributor .. ' provided the research for use by EDFM under the same license as the rest of the project. The current dataset was compiled on '
        .. humanDate(data.generated)
        .. '.</p>'
end

local render = {}

function render.table(frame)
    return allFamilyTables()
end

function render.attribution(frame)
    return attributionLine()
end

function render.material(frame)
    local id = materialId(frame)
    local item = material(id)
    if not item then error('Unknown material: ' .. id, 0) end
    local observations = item.observations or {}
    local observationCount = listLength(observations)
    if observationCount == 0 then error('Material has no observations: ' .. id, 0) end

    local highest, highestIndex = bestObservation(observations)
    local clauses = {}
    for _, observation in ipairs(observations) do
        clauses[#clauses + 1] = escape(observation.hits) .. ' of '
            .. escape(observation.locations_surveyed) .. ' surveyed '
            .. escape(groundLabel(observation.ground)) .. ' locations ('
            .. percentage(observation.observed_percentage) .. ')'
    end

    local out = {'Community prospecting observations place ' .. escape(item.name) .. ' at '
        .. table.concat(clauses, ' and ') .. '.'}
    if observationCount > 1 then
        out[#out + 1] = 'In the current dataset, ' .. escape(groundLabel(highest.ground))
            .. ' had the highest observed share for ' .. escape(item.name) .. '.'
    end
    out[#out + 1] = 'These are community observations, not official Frontier-published spawn or drop rates.'
    out[#out + 1] = observationsTable(item)
    out[#out + 1] = '<small>Community observations contributed by ' .. escape((data.attribution or {}).contributor or 'CMDR Grumlop') .. '.</small>'
    return table.concat(out, '\n\n')
end

for name, fn in pairs(render) do
    p[name] = function(frame)
        local ok, result = pcall(fn, frame)
        if ok then return result end
        return diagnostic(result)
    end
end

return p
